caption: The drawing depicts a pitcher with a hexagonal base and a prominent, angular handle on the right side. The main body of the pitcher is shaded in a beige or light tan color, while blue decorative elements adorn its surface. The blue decorations feature a pastoral outdoor scene with a figure in a dress, trees, a column, and a small boat on the water. Blue ornamental patterns also outline the rim, the spout, and the lower base of the pitcher. The pitcher has a wide, outward-flaring lip on the left side and a sturdy handle with angular squarish bends and curves. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a separate detailed rendering of the handle, vertically oriented, and labeled "EXACT SIZE." The name "JOHN L. CUTTING" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the image. The pitcher is framed by a lightly drawn rectangular border centered on the page. The artwork is executed in a combination of line drawing, blue shading, and light washes of color.
title: Syrup Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
